Pakistan Cricket Coach Denies Player Refused King Charles Meeting

Pakistan cricket coach Mike Hesson has denied reports that player Salman Ali Agha refused to meet King Charles. Hesson stated that the reports were fabricated and that Salman Ali Agha had been informed in advance that he would not be part of the Buckingham Palace visit. He described the reporting as "unacceptable journalism."
